messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: team Dune owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The image resizer's storage for original uploads doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- The product catalog depends on the image resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-04-14]
- On 2025-10-15, the Atlas team noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the image resizer's owners. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-15]
- As of 2026-03-17, the image resizer keeps original uploads for only 90 days. [decision; valid 2026-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-17]
- Team Dune observed that the image resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade. [valid 2025-08-19 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-19-2]
- As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team. [constraint; valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Atlas team. [constraint; valid 2025-05-20 to 2026-04-01; recorded by handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer is owned by the Cinder team. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-05-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-06-25, the job scheduler is owned by team Dune. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-scheduler]
    earlier: The job scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-09-05, team Dune still owns the job scheduler. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-09-23; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-05]
- As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- The Boreal team adopted a weekly dependency update day. [decision; valid 2025-12-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-18]
- On 2026-06-09, team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. [valid 2026-06-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-09]
- On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team reported that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-23-scheduler]
- Lena takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Marcus in the cycle starting 2025-03-17. [decision; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
    earlier: Marcus takes over the pager rotation for the Boreal team from Lena on 2025-02-12. [decision; valid 2025-02-12 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-12]
    earlier: Lena takes the first pager rotation for the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-02-12; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-4]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]

Question: As of now, which team is responsible for image-resizer?
